characters.description: A blind newcomer from Earth who finds shelter near River Farm. After deciding to defend Durene and her home, he claims the title of Emperor and gains a class that makes his declaration real.
characters.name: Laken Godart

characters.description: An exceptionally strong and isolated farmer who shelters Laken after his arrival. River Farm relies on her labor while keeping her at a distance, and she is guarded about the reason for the villagers' fear.
characters.name: Durene

characters.description: A River Farm farmer who accepts Laken as a stranded traveler while warning him to keep away from Durene.
characters.name: Prost

characters.description: The half-Elf captain of the re-formed Horns of Hammerad. She leads the impoverished party's expedition into Albez and uses magic to move her skeletal left hand.
characters.name: Ceria

characters.description: A necromancer and mage in the Horns of Hammerad. His companions object to his undead servants, but their desperate excavation at Albez depends on the skeletons he creates.
characters.name: Pisces

characters.description: A frontline fighter in the Horns of Hammerad. She is wary of Pisces and his necromancy, but joins the rest of the party in using every available advantage to survive Albez.
characters.name: Yvlon

characters.description: An Antinium fighter in the Horns of Hammerad. Though still learning adventuring customs, he is an effective combatant whose body resists creller venom.
characters.name: Ksmvr

characters.description: An Earth-born innkeeper temporarily stranded in Esthelm. She experiments with unusual food at Octavia's shop while seeking protection and a safe route back to Liscor.
characters.name: Erin

characters.description: A classless runner from Earth looking for work and a safe journey back to Liscor. She carries a dragon's spellbook and other possessions, but her insistence on familiar physical rules obstructs her attempts to learn conventional magic.
characters.name: Ryoka

characters.description: The one Frost Faerie who remains with Ryoka after the others lose interest. She has guided and warned Ryoka before, and now offers a friendship whose consequences she considers dangerous.
characters.name: Ivolethe

characters.description: A rival runner whose newly gained movement skill gives her speed far beyond her former ability.
characters.name: Persua

characters.description: An alchemist who gives Erin space to conduct food experiments. Her shop becomes the base for testing whether magical ingredients and Erin's cooking can produce useful effects.
characters.name: Octavia

characters.description: A princess serving as Erin's barmaid, left alone at the closed Wandering Inn. Barred from Liscor and nearly without food or money, she attempts to operate the inn herself.
characters.name: Lyonette

characters.description: One of the surviving Antinium Individuals from Erin's chess club and the first worker to choose a name. He secretly holds an Acolyte class and a Prayer skill, and seeks guidance about whether any god will accept him.
characters.name: Pawn

characters.description: A senior Antinium official in Liscor's Hive. Pawn intends to disclose his hidden religious class to him, trusting his authority despite having no idea how he will respond.
characters.name: Klbkch

characters.description: A Liscor tactician who agrees to buy and deliver ingredients for Lyonette's attempt to reopen the Wandering Inn. He helps on commercial terms and expects to be paid.
characters.name: Olesm

characters.description: A twenty-four-year-old medical student from Earth who joins a mercenary battalion in Baleros for food and safety. She gains the Doctor class after committing herself to treat the sick and injured despite having little equipment.
characters.name: Geneva Scala

characters.description: A high-level rogue whose species lives within other bodies. She survives Geneva's desperate attempt to move her from a destroyed host into a corpse, then becomes an assistant at the overwhelmed medical post.
characters.name: The self-bodied rogue

characters.description: A powerful northern noble who sends her household to summon Ryoka. Her purpose is not disclosed, and her representatives will not promise Ryoka's safety.
characters.name: Magnolia Reinhart

characters.description: Magnolia Reinhart's head maid and enforcer. She accompanies the order that Ryoka attend Magnolia's estate and has the authority to make refusal difficult.
characters.name: Ressa

characters.description: The leader of a northbound goblin force who recognizes Ryoka when Magnolia Reinhart's carriage crosses her column.
characters.name: Rags

characters.description: A starving orphaned eaglet adopted by Laken and Durene. Laken forms a magical bond with her after accepting her as one of his subjects.
characters.name: Frostwing

characters.description: A Drake washerwoman raised by human adoptive parents in a human city. She supports her younger brother Grev despite the physical damage caused by her work, and Erin offers them shelter and employment.
characters.name: Jasi

characters.description: Jasi's younger adoptive brother, a habitual thief whose next offense may bring exile. Erin gives him food and a room while taking responsibility for the risk of his behavior.
characters.name: Grev

characters.description: A man who privately wishes he could become a knight. When Erin searches for a new future for Jasi and Grev, he joins her proposed play and begins to discover confidence as an actor.
characters.name: Wesle

characters.description: Erin's skeleton, now acting beyond her immediate control. He kills travelers, pursues stronger opponents to gain levels, and discovers personal desires and hatreds as his independent mind develops.
characters.name: Toren

characters.description: A Redfang leader who secretly sends thirteen warriors to kill a human innkeeper. The warriors question whether his order violates Rags' authority.
characters.name: Garen

characters.description: A Redfang warrior among the thirteen goblins sent on Garen's covert mission. He helps reject the order and turn the isolated band back toward Rags.
characters.name: Head Scratcher

characters.description: A former florist trapped in ruined Esthelm. Starvation and eating the dead have transformed her into a wordless, clawed figure driven by terrible hunger while undead rise around the city.
characters.name: The famine-altered woman

characters.description: The Hobgoblin leading thirteen Redfang warriors trapped in Esthelm. His band is cut off from Rags and pursued by the Goblin Lord's forces.
characters.name: Grunter

characters.description: A Redfang archer fleeing through Esthelm with Grunter's band. He kills a man threatening a lost child but leaves the child unharmed.
characters.name: Bad Arrow

characters.description: An unnamed gold-rank knight who rallies Esthelm's surviving citizens and organizes them to rebuild and defend the city.
characters.name: The gold-rank defender

characters.description: Liscor's Watch commander. She conditionally approves a twenty-soldier Antinium patrol outside the city while recording the unusual request and her concern about the Hive's intentions.
characters.name: Zevara

characters.description: A young Gnoll who runs to the Wandering Inn and refuses to leave with Selys. Lyonette offers her protection and takes responsibility for her care.
characters.name: The young white-furred Gnoll
